name: inavitas-staj
description: Elektrik dağıtımı kesinti & iş emri yönetim modülü

scripts.dev: concurrently -n access,outage,workorder,gw,web -c magenta,green,yellow,cyan,blue "npm run dev -w services/access-service" "npm run dev -w services/outage-service" "npm run dev -w services/work-order-service" "npm run dev -w services/gateway" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/contracts && npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.db:migrate: npm run db:migrate -w services/access-service && npm run db:migrate -w services/outage-service && npm run db:migrate -w services/work-order-service
